page.overview:
Who is Elikka?

Elikka of Stormpeak was a female cyclops historian who resided in her lair, hidden away in a mountain range in Tal'Dorei, as of 812 PD. As a historian, she was considered an oddity among her people, and it was said that her lair contained documents and treatises on the origins of the cyclops race and that she helped train new cyclops stormcallers in exchange for keeping her updated on what was going on in cyclops society.

So far, Elikka has not appeared nor been mentioned onstream.
